900.3.10(316).explanation: Exception RD 316 (Scarborough RD lands) keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, sets a 1.2 m side yard (3.6 m on a street side, 0.3 m for a garage on an interior side), a 9.0 m front setback on Pharmacy Ave., a 36.0 m setback from the centreline of Victoria Park, Warden or Sheppard, and a 3.6 m setback from Abbottsfield Lane for named Sheppard Ave. E. and Abbottsfield Gate lots. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(340).explanation: Exception RD 340 sets a 0.9 m side yard (3.6 m on a street side) and a 22 m setback from the centreline of Birchmount, St. Clair, Danforth or Kennedy; 76-80 Cleta Dr. need 11.5 m frontage and 464 m2 area, and 730-734 Danforth Rd. need 15.2 m frontage. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(99).explanation: Exception RD 99 keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as the minimums, sets a 1.2 m side yard (4.5 m on a street side, 0.3 m for a garage) and a 30.0 m setback from the centreline of Markham Rd. No prevailing by-laws apply.
